reason: The frozen controls legitimately contain workplace abbreviations such as QR/CCTV. Treating mere Latin-token presence as intrusion would make byte-identical ABSTAIN fail by construction.

operational_definition.foreign_script_intrusion: FAIL only when Treatment introduces an ASCII alphabetic token absent from its paired Control, excluding P1..Pn speaker labels. Preserved Control tokens are not intrusion.
operational_definition.critical_malformed_korean: FAIL on newly introduced critical grammatical/encoding corruption that makes the Treatment materially malformed; ordinary stylistic disagreement is not this gate.

frozen_output_effect: No generated Control or Treatment text is modified by this amendment.
